title: Wickedness: The Grain of Evil Seed

sense.text:
“Yet the Lord testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways”. That goes for back then and it goes for us today. “And keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.” Just as it was true back then, it is true for us today.

The class stirred this up: so many people stealing in IUIC, brothers you thought were in the spirit and you find out they are not in the spirit. That’s why Paul said they are not all Israel. Some brothers repent and get themselves situated, get themselves right; but some brothers are CGR, can’t get right.

precepts.why:
“Nevertheless they were disobedient”: we as a nation, as a people, were disobedient, “and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs”. For example, the law says thou shalt not steal; what do brothers do? Still steal, and we said ‘ah, the hell with that’.

“And slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee”. It always starts off with hatred first: the spirit of hatred, and then it leads to the spirit of murder. That’s what it means by “slew thy prophets”. “And they wrought great provocations.”

“Neither have we obeyed the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.” Every man and every woman here and listening online, take it to heart. Don’t ever read the Bible and say this only applies to that brother or that sister. When you hear these scriptures and these lessons, say that goes for me. That will help all of us, because even as the lesson goes, it pertains to the Bishop too.

“Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law”. It didn’t say some; it says all Israel. That includes me and you, all of us. “Even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.”

That curse poured upon us and the oath written in the law of Moses is what the class goes on to discuss in brief.

sense.text:
A theologian, Eric Mason of the Urban Apologetics, said Deuteronomy is not a book of prophecy. These urban apologetics are stupid. “I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men”. So Eric Mason, my brother of the urban apologetics: if Deuteronomy has no prophecies in it, what is that talking about?

All Israel came out of Egypt, we all came out of Egypt walking together to the promised land. Everybody knew about the children of Israel: when we walked through the ranks of the Amalekites and the Canaanites, they said, those are the children of Israel. But now our remembrance has ceased from among men.

Brothers and sisters, stop listening to these Christians; they don’t know the Bible. We are them guys. We are who the prophets are speaking of.

“But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee”. The class read some of the curses in brief, with pictures, to show that the curses of Deuteronomy are real.

Deuteronomy 28:15-68, in summation, is slavery, colonialism, loss of identity and oppression. Those four things sum up all the curses of God. Write that down. The churches don’t want to talk about it; well, guess what, we gonna talk about it.

precepts.why:
Slavery. “Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people”. An actual photograph: a sister who is a slave, who didn’t want to be in the photo, and the Arab guy has a whip in his hand to whip our sister.

“And thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.” No might in our hands: no economic might, no military might and no political might. That’s slavery.

Colonialism. “The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up”. Write this down: this is colonialism. In Rwanda they got our people picking coffee, and then they send the coffee out to be processed in America or Britain, and then they sell it back at an exorbitant price. In Kenya, tea: they pick the tea leaves, export them to America or Britain, which processes them and sells it back at an exorbitant price. This is all neocolonialism. This ain’t the old time; this is current.

They are in the mines, mining for gold, diamonds, amethyst, bauxite. How many sisters want to work in a mine with a baby on your back? This is for you complaining sisters: some of you got cushy jobs in corporate America and wouldn’t dare do this, but this is what they do on a day-to-day basis. Over here we got central heat and air; that is part of this. A twelve-year-old boy doing hard labor; some of our sons ain’t done hard work a day in their life, the most they do is sweep the floor, mop the kitchen and throw out the garbage. There ain’t no baby setup there. This is colonialism.

Africa is one of the largest diamond-producing regions in the world, exporting from Botswana, South Africa, Namibia and Angola. Gold from South Africa, Ghana, Tanzania, Mali and Burkina Faso; emeralds from Zambia; tanzanite from Tanzania; rubies from Mozambique and Madagascar; sapphires from Madagascar; garnets from Namibia and Mozambique; amethyst from Zambia and Namibia. And the foods we love to eat: avocados from Kenya, South Africa and Tanzania; mangoes from Burkina Faso and Senegal; pineapples from Ghana and Mozambique; papayas from Cameroon; passion fruit from Kenya and South Africa; sweet potatoes from Nigeria and Uganda; green beans from Kenya and Ethiopia; okra from Cameroon and Nigeria; bell peppers from Morocco and Tunisia. Notice: everything is export. It’s going out of Africa.

The nation which thou knowest not eats it up, because the European nations eat up those resources. They do not benefit any of our people on the continent at all; it’s all for the benefit of Britain, America or their allies. “And thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway”: that’s why these are modern pictures, in case you think we’re not going through that right now. People are still going through this.

“So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.” You get mad when you see this, because as long as one of us is a slave, none of us are free. Don’t say, oh, that’s just them over there. That’s your brother, that’s your sister over there.

Loss of identity. “And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the Lord shall lead thee”. That verse explains the loss of identity, like Deuteronomy 32:26 about our remembrance being taken from us.

Our people don’t know. Ask our people who they are in the Bible and you get the confused look. Or ‘I’m a child of God’: which one? Name them. A child of God is not a race, not a people in the Bible. Who are you? ‘I’m black, brother, I am black.’

“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.”

A book from 1898, The Flaming Torch in Darkest Africa, by William Taylor, a white man, says the Hebrew nation is at present scattered over the face of the habitable globe. That is what we read here in verse 64. It says they are numerous in some parts of Asia, particularly the Turkish dominions; that various countries in Africa contain a large number, as Egypt and Ethiopia; and that four hundred thousand are computed in Morocco, Algiers and Fez. Eric Mason, your slave master put this together.

Oppression. “And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.” America from the 60s, the 80s and today: the same thing, protest after protest about racial discrimination.

sense.text:
“And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee”. That’s what Deuteronomy 28 and Deuteronomy 32:26 were talking about. Not only is this prophetic about Jeremiah himself, it’s prophetic about you and I.

The books written by the white man verify it: we started to discontinue from our heritage by being intermingled with the African tribes native to the land. A book from 1920 on the Bantu: Bantu is the term they use for the sons of Shem, the Shemitic blacks on the continent of Africa. There are two groups, the Hamitic blacks and the Shemitic blacks, and the Bantus are the ones we come from. It says groups of Israelitish peoples have from time to time journeyed into the upper Nile country, and that the extraneous element of the Bantu was derived from tribes of Israel which were first carried away to Babylon, as related in the scriptures, and afterward migrated through Egypt into equatorial Africa, and through mingling with native tribes, upon whom they imposed much of their own religion and customs, gave rise to the peoples now known as Bantu. Mingling with native tribes: the Philistines, the Canaanites, the Jebusites, whatever names they go by now; we mingled with the Nilotic tribes, we had babies with them. Eric Mason, the Bishop didn’t write that book; your slave master wrote that book.

The 1898 book says the custom to this day of some of the tribes of living in booths constructed from the branches of trees at a certain season of the year, observing ceremonies identical with those of the children of Israel, and the practice of circumcision so general among the Zulus, seem to link them with the period following the Exodus; and the traditional history of the Abyssinians connects it with that of the Jews, recording the visit of the Queen of Sheba to King Solomon. They noted the Zulus affiliated with the Israelites. They are the Israelites, and they know that.

The large number in the Turkish dominions, Algeria and Morocco: those are what they call the Afro-Turks and the Afro-Algerians. The Arabs took that place over now, but there are remnants of our people there. When you search, always put afro in front of it and you’ll see our people right there. They keep our people hidden from the general public so you think only Arabs are over there.

precepts.why: The Lord said we would discontinue from our heritage. In order for us to regain the knowledge we once had, Christ says: “If ye love me, keep my commandments. And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever; Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.”

“But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost”: this is the one the Lord said he would give us if we keep the commandments. You want the Holy Ghost? What you got to do, brothers: keep the commandments.

“He shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.” We discontinued from our heritage that the Lord gave us, and the Lord Christ said, don’t worry, I’m going to send you the Holy Ghost; he’s gonna bring all things to your remembrance.

sense.text: “I beseech thee, O Lord, let me have understanding”. Ezra already had understanding, but he wanted a higher level of understanding.

“For it was not my mind to be curious of the high things”. The angel Uriel was getting on him, so Ezra had to come back and say it’s not his mind to be curious of high things. Some of us be curious of high things, asking what the kingdom is gonna look like. How are we gonna know? All we can give is a biblical description. How tall Christ is going to be? That’s too high; we gotta wait and see.

“But of such as pass by us daily”: regular things on earth. “Wherefore Israel is given up as a reproach to the heathen, and for what cause the people whom thou hast loved is given over unto ungodly nations”: why are we given over unto ungodly nations? At this time we were under Persia-Media, not the Greeks. “And why the law of our forefathers is brought to nought, and the written covenants come to none effect”.

“And we pass away out of the world as grasshoppers, and our life is astonishment and fear, and we are not worthy to obtain mercy.” Ezra acknowledges how wicked we as a people are: we are not worthy to receive mercy.
“What will he then do unto his name whereby we are called?” Lord, what are you going to do with the name of Israel? “Of these things have I asked”: that’s what Ezra wants to know.

Ezra is talking to the archangel Uriel. “The more thou searchest, the more thou shalt marvel”: the more you try to search that out, the more you’re going to be shocked. “For the world hasteth fast to pass away”: the world is going by fast.

“And cannot comprehend the things that are promised to the righteous in time to come”. That’s why the Lord said ‘eyes have not seen’ what the Lord has prepared for those that love him. It’s beyond our understanding, our comprehension. “For this world is full of unrighteousness and infirmities.”
“For the evil is sown, but the destruction thereof is not yet come.” Evil is sown into the earth, but the end, the destruction, has not come yet.

“If therefore that which is sown be not turned upside down”: there’s a lot in there, and the class peeled back the onion on this verse. Evil is sown in the earth, and the angel tells Ezra that if that evil is not turned upside down, it won’t come. The grain of evil seed must be turned upside down. So our job, brothers and sisters, is to turn the evil upside down, and then the Lord will step in.

“And if the place where the evil is sown pass not away”: meaning made empty, destroyed, like Isaiah 24:1. “Then cannot it come that is sown with good”: then the kingdom cannot come. If that does not happen, the kingdom cannot come.

Don’t think we’re not going to pay a price for this. Did not Christ pay a price? Did not Paul, James and John pay a price? Even Mary and Martha; all the women of God paid the price.

precepts.why:
“Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord”. Prophetically, nowadays, this is the so-called white man: a group of people who have counsel they think the Lord don’t see. “And their works are in the dark”: all the evil that they do is in the dark. Today they call this think tanks: men and women, the smartest of the nations, the ones that go to places like Yale, Harvard and Oxford, the crème de la crème, the cream of the crop, and they pay them millions of dollars each.

There was a robbery in Manhattan and the Bishop’s unit was called. A white man got beat up and robbed, and in his room were books all over the whole huge apartment, on the floor, on the walls, everywhere. They could all smell the weed; that’s why he was robbed. Asked what he does for a living, he said he works for a think tank, a very popular think tank: he gets paid to read. He only goes out of his house maybe once a week for groceries. They call him, give him a subject and say, we want you to give us an insight on this. Then at the end of the month or two months they all get together on how to confound: rap music, drugs, feminism. This is how you do it. They read all the history books and search out things you would not believe. They got books we ain’t got, books Negroes ain’t never seen.

“And they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?” Who would believe it’s us? They think they can never be figured out.

“Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay”. They have turned God’s words upside down. That’s what the archangel Uriel was telling Ezra: if this grain of evil seed be not turned upside down, it won’t come; it must be turned upside down. Isaiah is prophesying to us. They turn God’s laws, this whole world, upside down: righteousness is evil and evil is righteousness.

The potter’s clay: on the potter’s wheel it spins real fast, and with the clay you can make anything, a cup or a tray, whatever. And whatever you make, you can undo too: if you don’t like it you can just push it down, because the clay is real soft, malleable.

“For shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not?” We’re the work; God made us. “Or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?” That’s what the white man says: there is no God, he didn’t make me.

“And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also”. They said the disciples have turned the world upside down, meaning they turned it right side up. The prophets’ job, the disciples’ job: all that evil that we see, turn it upside down, meaning right side up.

That’s our job: we see the evil, we gotta turn the evil upside down, making it right side up. “For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal”: we’re not using guns and knives and sticks or bats, “but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”. Brothers and sisters, our job is to pull down strongholds. Christianity is a stronghold; we must pull it down. Islam is a stronghold; we must pull it down. Egyptology is a stronghold; we must pull it down. Feminism is a stronghold; we must pull it down. The LGBT community is a stronghold; we must pull it down. Just to name a few.

“Casting down imaginations”: we must cast down all evil imaginations. You might imagine Jesus Christ is white; our job is to cast that thought down. You might imagine Christ was born December 25th; our job is to cast that down, using the Bible of course. You might imagine the woman is the head of society; we have to cast that imagination down.

“And every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God”: our job is to cast down every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, meaning against the Bible. “And bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ”: we got to bring every man and every woman’s thought to what this Bible says, so they acknowledge, yes, the word of God is true.

“Behold, the Lord maketh the earth empty”: he’s going to wipe these nations out. “And maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down”: meaning he’s going to turn everything right side up. The wicked already turned it upside down, so when God turns it upside down it’s gonna be right side up.

But it starts with us. The Lord ain’t gonna do nothing until we put the boots on the ground. You men, fulfill your role in the street; you women, teach them children, teach them young sisters. Cast down all evil imaginations; turn every lie upside down. Then God’s gonna step in. And when the Lord steps in, he “scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof”: he’s gonna scatter the nations, and destruction.

sense.text:
“For the grain of evil seed hath been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning”: when God created Adam he put an evil heart in him. Why would God do that? The Most High made it that way; that was his plan from the beginning.

“And how much ungodliness hath it brought up unto this time? and how much shall it yet bring forth until the time of threshing come?” It’s going to get worse and worse until the time of threshing come. What is the time of threshing? Jeremiah 51:33: the threshing of the daughter of Babylon.

“Ponder now by thyself, how great fruit of wickedness the grain of evil seed hath brought forth.” The angel tells Ezra: I want you to ponder on this, think about this, meditate on this, from the time of Adam until the time of threshing, how great the fruit of wickedness is that the grain of evil seed hath brought forth. Now the question might be, how much fruit of wickedness has come forth? Let’s just take a look: First Timothy 1:9.

precepts.why:
Paul told you the same thing. If you had the question why did Adam listen to Eve: the Most High made it that way. “For the creature was made subject to vanity”: the creature means man, beginning with Adam, and vanity means sin. Adam was made subject to sin.

“Not willingly”: not saying, Lord, I want to sin; that’s not what Adam’s mindset was. “But by reason of him”: by reason of God, “who hath subjected the same in hope”. His plan was to subject man in hope, hoping in his son Christ. That’s what God’s plan was from the beginning.

“For the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him.” The same grain of evil seed sown in the heart of Adam: he bore a wicked heart, and so do all born of him.

The same thing being said in the New Testament. “For Adam was first formed, then Eve”: Adam was formed first, then came the woman. “And Adam was not deceived”: he was not tricked. “But the woman being deceived was in the transgression”: the woman was the one deceived by the serpent; Adam was not.

So once again, why did Adam sin, why did he follow her? Because God put that wicked heart in him, and he said, you know what, I’m going to listen to her. That’s what we call today presumptuous sin: I know it’s wrong but I’m gonna do it anyway. That was God’s plan from the beginning, and that’s what Paul was making reference to. Adam was not tricked, so stop saying that; he knew exactly what he was doing.

Ezra is complaining: “O thou Adam, what hast thou done? for though it was thou that sinned, thou art not fallen alone, but we all that come of thee.” You ain’t fallen alone, Adam. That’s why David said, in sin did my mother conceive me: all of us are born with that sin nature in us.

“For what profit is it unto us, if there be promised us an immortal time, whereas we have done the works that bring death?” We’re sinning, we’re breaking God’s laws. “Whereas ourselves being most wicked are made vain”. “And that there are laid up for us dwellings of health and safety, whereas we have lived wickedly?” We’re not going to attain to that; we’re not going to get it. “Whereas we have walked in the most wicked ways of all”: that’s all of us in here, all of us listening.

“And that there should be shewed a paradise, whose fruit endureth for ever, wherein is security and medicine”: that paradise is New Jerusalem on earth, “since we shall not enter into it? (For we have walked in unpleasant places.)” The unpleasant places is sin.

“And that the faces of them which have used abstinence shall shine above the stars”: abstinence means when you refrain yourself from breaking God’s laws. Those men and women have abstained from worshipping other gods, from dishonouring their parents, from killing, from stealing, from committing adultery, from bearing false witness against their neighbour. “Whereas our faces shall be blacker than darkness?”

“For while we lived and committed iniquity”: we broke God’s commandments, “we considered not that we should begin to suffer for it after death.” Don’t let a Black Hebrew Israelite fool you and say you can sin all you want and when you die you’re going to become a baby in the kingdom. That’s a lie. You’re going to live the life of Riley, commit adultery, steal, lie, and still get the kingdom of heaven in Jesus’ name, amen? It says you’re gonna suffer after you die. That’s some heavy stuff; that should put some fear in you.

sense.text:
This explains the time of threshing in 2 Esdras 4:30. “The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor”: God calls Edom the daughter of Babylon, and the daughter of Babylon is America. “It is time to thresh her”.

To thresh is to separate grain from a plant, typically with a flail or by the action of a revolving mechanism: the machine that separates the grain, the wheat from the chaff. So America, the daughter of Babylon, is going to be threshed, wherein God separates the wheat from the chaff. And the synonyms: beat up, clobbered, crushed, defeated, overwhelmed, pummelled, spanked. The daughter of Babylon is going to get beat up. That’s some good stuff right there.

“Yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.”

precepts.why:
Who is the daughter of Babylon? “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom”. Who’s Edom? Esau, the so-called white man. Some of you see him and you think, oh, it’s Brad Pitt, he’s such a hunk; this is the children of Edom. “In the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.”

“O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”: see what God is calling Edom, the daughter of Babylon, and that’s America. “Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us”: the prophecy says happy shall he be that rewards Babylon as Babylon has rewarded us, the children of Israel.

This is when Christ returns. “The mountains saw thee, and they trembled”: the mountains saw Christ; the nations are going to tremble when they see him. “The overflowing of the water passed by”: the nations overflowed and passed by. “The deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high. The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went”: the light of God’s arrows is the missiles, “and at the shining of thy glittering spear”: that’s the missiles, the ICBMs.

“Thou didst march through the land in indignation”: indignation is righteous anger. “Thou didst thresh the heathen in anger”: thresh, pummel, beat up the nations in anger. That’s the time of threshing.

sense.text:
“And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen”. That’s prophecy. Just as John in Revelation saw the fall of Babylon, which is a metaphor for the United States of America, Isaiah saw the same thing: the fall of America, the fall of the daughter of Babylon, the fall of Babylon the great.

“And all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground”: God is going to destroy all the graven images here in America and cast them down. The Statue of Liberty is a graven image that nations worldwide worship; they all want to come here and pledge allegiance to the United States of America. And that is just one of millions that is here.
“O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.” The time of threshing again.

“The burden of Dumah.” Who is Dumah? Ishmael: Dumah is one of the sons of Ishmael, so the burden of Dumah is the burden of the Arabs. Christian apologists don’t know nothing.

“He calleth to me out of Seir”: Mount Seir is what they call Petra today, adjacent to the land of Israel. The Nabataeans who settled there were nomadic Arabs: once Esau left that area, the Arabs took it over. That’s where the Arabs dwelt. “Watchman, what of the night?” The watchmen are the prophets.
“The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.”

“The burden upon Arabia.” Not only is God prophesying about the fall of America, now he talks about the Arabs. “In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim”: that goes right back to Genesis 25.

“The inhabitants of the land of Tema”: Tema was another son of Ishmael; these are still the Arab nations. “Brought water to him that was thirsty”: when Babylon falls a lot of them are going to flee to Saudi Arabia, in the desert, thirsty, needing the Arabs’ help. “They prevented with their bread him that fled.”

“For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword”: going into these missiles, “and from the bent bow”: that’s ICBMs, “and from the grievousness of war.” War is going to be upon America and the Arabs.

“And all the glory of Kedar shall fail”: who’s Kedar? Ishmael, the Arabs. “And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished”: they’re gonna get wiped out. “For the Lord God of Israel hath spoken it.” The Lord said the Arabs are going to be wiped out; they ain’t taking a damn thing over. Don’t get mad; this is what the Bible say. Some of y’all in the ghettos having sex with the Arabs, having a little Arab baby, sister: that little Arab child gonna get taken away. Sorry to tell you what the Bible say. Sorry, not sorry.

This is all in love. We don’t hate the Arabs; our job is to prophesy and tell everyone what’s going to happen to them. You guys are racist, you just hate? No, we just prophesying what the Bible say.

precepts.why: “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils”. Just as John saw the fall of Babylon, which is a metaphor for the United States of America, Isaiah saw the same thing.

Who is Dumah? “These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam, And Mishma”. Dumah is among the sons of Ishmael: the burden of Dumah is the burden of the Arabs. Kedar, whose glory shall fail in Isaiah 21:16, is a son of Ishmael too.

sense.text:
This is the fruit of wickedness the grain of evil seed hath brought forth. “Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man”: remember what we read earlier, we got to turn everything upside down. “But for the lawless and disobedient”.

A young lady dealing with her friend’s mother, and then the sister gets killed, fifteen years old, at a party. We’re not gloating at that. But on the news they all say she was such a loving, beautiful person. That’s why when our people get on the news we don’t listen; you’re lying. The devil is a liar.

“For the ungodly and for sinners”. A Christian woman says God does not reject Gentiles and only accept Jews. What did she not use in her conversation? The Bible. That’s the norm for Christians: they never use the scriptures, and if they ever pick up the Bible they cherry pick. The world would like to believe the Lord has this harmonious thought that all people are the same and everybody loves everybody, but realistically that ain’t how God thinks. That’s why that sister didn’t use the Bible.

Another lovely Christian sister, the Nubian queen: she left her baby at home so she could be on social media and party; just to get her groove on she will allow her daughter to die. Another Christian queen of the universe drops her three kids off at her mama’s house because her new boyfriend said, I’m not being a step daddy to some other man’s kids; she says she’s tired of being a single parent. She should have closed her legs. Hold your legs. The next man is gonna give her some more kids, and she’s gonna take them right back to her mama, and move on to the next dude who don’t want to be a father to her kids either. It’s a cycle.

“For unholy and profane”. A preacher locked up, accused of stealing more than a hundred thousand dollars from his day job: that’s your Christian minister. For some reason a Christian apologist never sees fellow Christians caught up in unholiness and profanity. Then the black Christian woman, the queen of the universe, the prophetess, in Haiti: that is profane. Where’s the Christian apologists? They don’t see this; only we see this. Where’s the rebuke?

“For murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers”: a married father of five shot down walking to the grocery store, and a man who killed his girlfriend and his young daughter and nearly killed his son. All these laws, which is what Paul is teaching us, apply to our people now. Sisters look at a brother like that and say he’s handsome, he’s my type; some brothers are on psych meds or need psych meds. Our sisters are put to death, and the kids too. This is what happens because you don’t do a diligent search.

“For manslayers”: manslayers goes into manslaughter. Two women got drunk and crashed, and two toddlers were killed: that’s manslaughter; they didn’t mean to kill those two babies. Some of y’all have tendencies to get drunk and then drive home with children in the car. We always get on the white man being the devil, and yes he is the devil, but before we can deal with the white man, we got to deal with our own people.

“For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind”: the homo brother and the lesbo sister. We know you’re out there. And the agenda: ‘we’ll convert your children’. That’s the whole agenda of the LGBT community, to get your children adapted to that lifestyle.

“For menstealers”: the modern term is human trafficking, kidnapping. In the black and Latino community there’s something called human trafficking: they’re kidnapping you to make merchandise of you.

“For liars, for perjured persons”: perjury is the offense of willfully telling an untruth in a court after having taken an oath or affirmation, willingly lying after taking an oath in court. Christians will lie at the drop of a dime to prove their point; the Christian apologists, the urban apologists, they all lie constantly and consistently.

“And if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine”: Paul says, in case there’s any other law I forgot to mention. These laws still pertain to our people.

“According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.” The law is according to the glorious gospel. Never let a Christian tell you God’s law has nothing to do with the gospel of Jesus Christ. That’s a lie; we’re reading it right here.

precepts.why: The disobedient. “Honour thy father and thy mother”. We don’t teach none of y’all up in here to disrespect your father and mother. If your father and mother is that bad, just move away from them. Why are you still in the house with them, eating their food, bothering their white Jesus on their walls?

“For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents”: that’s the disobedient of 1 Timothy 1:9.

Read again for unholy and profane: “disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy”. That’s the unholy, telling you what’s going to happen. This is the grain of evil seed that’s gotten worse and worse.
“They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him”: many of us profess we know God, but in our works we deny him, “being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.”
For the ungodly. “But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.”
For sinners. What does it mean to sin? Many of our people don’t understand the terminology. “Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.”

The Christian sister said God does not reject Gentiles; here is the one about Esau. “I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob, And I hated Esau”. God said he hates Esau; we ain’t making this up. “And laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.”

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished”: whereas the white man says we are impoverished, “but we will return and build the desolate places”. When did they rebuild the desolate places? The Renaissance era. “Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people”: man, woman, boy, girl, “against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” Indignation is righteous anger. How long? For ever.

Let’s see if God’s thoughts towards Edom have changed in the New Testament, because that’s what they’ll say: oh, that’s the Old Testament. “Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.”

“For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing”: because Jesus is about mercy and blessings and he loves everybody, right? “He was rejected”: he was rejected by God. You ain’t changing the Bible. “For he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.” Even though he was crying, trying to get repentance, none was shown for him. God ain’t changed. He said, I the Lord change not.
Unholy and profane. “Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.” The Lord is holy, and the commandment of God is holy: so to break it is unholy.

Let’s talk about profane for a second. “Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.”

“I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.” “For from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.”
Jump back up to verse 11: “For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the Lord.”
Profane. “Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.”

Manslayers goes into manslaughter. Write this down. “But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity”: enmity means hatred, “or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait”: he was not waiting for you, he doesn’t have hatred for you. This is what manslaughter is. “Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not”: you threw a stone but you didn’t see the brother or sister coming by.

“Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood”, and shall “restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest”. So if you kill somebody by accident, that’s manslaughter: you didn’t purposely kill a brother or sister, you made an error, you didn’t see them. You had to run to the city of refuge until the death of the high priest.

“And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood”. The revenger of blood is the family member. God’s law was, if you stepped out of the city of refuge before the high priest died and the revenger of blood finds you and kills you, there’s no judgment on him, “Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.”

Whoremongers. Some of you was knocking boots last night with someone that was not your spouse. “All bread is sweet to a whoremonger”. Sisters, it don’t matter what you look like: you can be a fat slob, you can have no teeth or one tooth in your head, you could be a drug addict, you can urinate on yourself as you walk down the street, there will be a man that will sex you. But there will not be a man that’s willing to spend his life with you and provide for you. Men are nasty, men are disgusting: he’ll sex you and he will leave you, and he will not provide for you or your sixteen kids by sixteen different men.

“He will not leave off till he die”: the only thing that can stop a whoremonger brother is death. You think your pretty face and your big BBL can stop him from being a whoremonger, sister? After a while the sex wears off and he says, I want something new, someone new.

“A man that breaketh wedlock, saying thus in his heart, Who seeth me? I am compassed about with darkness, the walls cover me, and no body seeth me; what need I to fear? the most High will not remember my sins: Such a man only feareth the eyes of men”: he fears the husband or the boyfriend coming home; that’s the only thing he fears. He don’t fear the Most High God, “and knoweth not that the eyes of the Lord are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, beholding all the ways of men, and considering the most secret parts.”

“This man shall be punished in the streets of the city, and where he suspecteth not he shall be taken.” That’s why some brothers get caught: the boyfriend or the husband been looking for you, and you wind up dead, and we like, what happened to this brother? We didn’t know you was a whoremonger. God sent that spirit to find you.

“Thus shall it go also with the wife that leaveth her husband, and bringeth in an heir by another.” The Lord didn’t forget you, sister: just like there’s whoremonger brothers, there’s whoremonger sisters. Some of you know that dude you had sex with last was not your husband; you’re bringing a baby by another dude. “For first, she hath disobeyed the law of the most High”: that law is thou shalt not commit adultery, “and secondly, she hath trespassed against her own husband”; and thirdly she has played in adultery “and brought children by another man.”

Them that defile themselves with mankind. “Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.” It’s an abomination for a man to pretend he’s a woman and to receive. You jailhouse brothers know what we’re talking about: I’m not gay because I’m not receiving, I just give. The hell is this?

“For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature”: that’s for you lesbian sisters. Brothers, if there’s a sister struggling in her past from being a lesbian, wait a minimum of five years. There’s been a situation where a sister got mad with her husband, and in the argument she told him, my girlfriend do me better than you, just to get under his skin.

“And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.” That recompence is a judgment for their error, for their sin: death.

Sisters, you see a brother, he’s just so handsome: he ain’t ready yet, because we know something about him you don’t know. You never asked the right question. It’s not about how many questions you ask, it’s asking the right questions: are you on psych meds is one, have you dealt in a same-sex relationship is another. A sister gets married and complains he never wants to have vaginal sex: that’s a red flag. He’s very rough in bed, squeezed her ankle so hard the bones almost broke, because he’s used to dealing with three-hundred-pound knuckles, and here you come at a hundred and twenty.

Menstealers: the modern term is human trafficking, kidnapping. Write that down. “If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel”: his people, “and maketh merchandise of him, or selleth him; then that thief shall die”. In the black and Latino community there’s something called human trafficking: kidnapping you to make merchandise of you.
Liars and perjured persons fall under this commandment: “Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.”
“A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips”: a person that is wicked gives heed to false lips, meaning a liar; “and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.”
“Use not to make any manner of lie: for the custom thereof is not good.”

Christian apologists say God does not judge you according to his law in the New Testament. That’s not true; this is why we’re going through 1 Timothy 1:9 and 10. “But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession, And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it”. “But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost”: this is about lying. Some of you brothers, some of you sisters are liars. “Thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God. And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost”.

Then his wife came in, and Peter said, “How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out. Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost”.

What have we learned? Most times when brothers are lying, stealing, doing some kind of wickedness, who’s often complicit with him? The wife. I didn’t know what my husband was doing; how did you get that brand new car? I don’t know, my husband just came into a lot of money. She’s lying. And God killed husband and wife: that’s the New Testament right there.

sense.text: Back to the title verses: “For the grain of evil seed hath been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning”. “Ponder now by thyself, how great fruit of wickedness the grain of evil seed hath brought forth.” I gave you an example of how great a wicked seed this world has brought forth. I just gave you a few examples, but there’s a lot more.

“And when the ears shall be cut down”. It’s like when you go through a cornfield and you cut down the ears of corn. The ears represent the people, “which are without number”. “How great a floor shall they fill?”

When Christ comes, it’s going to kill a lot of people. Christians will say no, you ain’t. Here’s the proof.
Then Ezra asks: “How, and when shall these things come to pass? wherefore are our years few and evil?” He wants to know when the end of all this wickedness will come.

“Do not thou hasten above the most Highest: for thy haste is in vain to be above him”. You can’t go above the Lord. This is Uriel’s warning to Ezra: “thou hast much exceeded”, you have gone too far in what you are asking.

“Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers”. When we die, we are in our chambers in heaven, and the righteous there ask the same question: “How long shall I hope on this fashion? when cometh the fruit of the floor of our reward?”

When will all this evil be over, and when shall we get a reward for keeping the commandments? That is the question. That is why, when we die, we ask the Lord when he is going to bring vengeance on them that dwell upon the earth, when he is going to bring judgment on America. When, Lord, when?

precepts.why: “For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.” Watch this: “For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.” Christ is going to kill a whole lot of people. A whole lot.

When the ears of corn shall be cut down, which are without number: “And the slain of the Lord shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth”. God is going to kill millions upon millions of people. That’s why I don’t see why people play with the Bible: I’m just going to be wicked and the Lord gonna forgive me. That ain’t what the Bible says.

“They shall not be lamented”: ain’t nobody gonna cry for your dead body. “Neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.” That’s what the Bible says. I ain’t making it up.

“The most High hath made this world for many, but the world to come for few.” God made this world for many, but the New Jerusalem for few. He compares it like dust: “There be many created, but few shall be saved.” There’s many created in this world, but few shall be saved. Christians can’t understand.

Watch this, about the other nations: “Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain”. The multitude of nations, God said let them perish, because they were born in vain. “And let my grape be kept, and my plant”: the nation of Israel. “For with great labour have I made it perfect.”

John tells the same thing Ezra was told about the dead in their chambers. “And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held”. And they cry “with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true”, dost thou “not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?” It is the same question: how long.

That shows you that when you die, brothers, you don’t die; when you die, sisters, you don’t die. Meaning the real you. We think the host we are in right now is the real us. It is not. This is the temporary thing; all these bodies go back to the dust. But the real man, the real woman, the real soul, the real spirit goes before the Lord, and you are living.

Ezra’s question was when cometh the fruit of the floor of our reward. Isaiah answers it: “Behold, the Lord hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him”. Thy salvation comes, and his reward is with him. We want that reward.

Remember what Ezra asked: when cometh the fruit of the floor of our reward, when will we get our reward for keeping the commandments. Christ speaks of the same reward: “Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven”. Rejoice about it. Don’t get mad.

“Great is your reward in heaven” means New Jerusalem on earth: thy kingdom come, thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

“For so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.” They persecuted the prophets before you the same way. That is the course we have to pay.

Read the verse above it: “Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.” Brothers, if you ain’t got no haters you are doing something wrong; you ain’t pushing the right buttons. When you are keeping the commandments you will get haters, like the geriatric crew out there that hate us.

“Falsely” is the key: when they speak falsely against you for Christ’s sake. That is when the reward of verse 12 is yours.

sense.text: “In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed”. He wrote the dream down, and now he explains it: the four beasts.

“The four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea. And four great beasts came up from the sea”. Four great beasts. They came up from the sea, meaning they came up from the people, “diverse one from another”: these four beasts were different one from another.

“The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings”. That represents Babylon. “I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked”, because Babylon conquered Assyria. It “was lifted up from the earth” and became a ruler of all nations. “A man’s heart was given to it”, meaning great wisdom was given to Babylon.

“Another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side”: one side became greater than the other. That is the Medes and the Persians. There was a joint union, and the Medes came in first, but then the Persians became greater than the Medes.

“It had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”. Write this down: the three ribs are Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans, which is Somalia. “And they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.”

“After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard”. The leopard represents the Greeks. “Which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl”: they had four major groups. “The beast had also four heads”: the Greeks had four generals. “And dominion was given to it.”

“After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly”. Now we are talking about the fourth beast, the one we are living in. This fourth beast represents Rome, the Roman Empire. “And it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces”.

“And stamped the residue with the feet of it”. Think about that. In slavery, when America stamped upon us, they not only literally put a branding iron on our flesh to show whose property we were; they also stamped Christianity in our minds, the lies of the Christians. Another word for stamped, in the New Testament, is the mark: they put their mark on us. It stamped the residue of us with its feet, meaning it imprinted us with their lies, their philosophies. Whoever gets it, gets it.

“It was diverse from all the beasts that were before it”: it was different. Diverse from Greece, diverse from Persia and Media, diverse from Babylon. This last empire is different.

Notice it doesn’t give the animal description. This is what the white man does: they make the fourth beast Godzilla, and dumb Christians go, see, it’s Godzilla, it’s the animal symbol. No. The Bible tells you what it is: Ezra was told the eagle is the kingdom seen in the vision of his brother Daniel.

“And it had ten horns.” The ten horns represent NATO, the European Union. Write that down. John talked about the same thing in Revelation, only he used a dragon; they are all metaphors. The ten common markets: Greece, France, Luxembourg, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Belgium, Italy, the Netherlands, Germany and them. There are more than that, but there are ten major ones the Bible is talking about.

“I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn”. The little horn is the United States of America.

“Before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots”. To provide themselves a more perfect union, they destroyed the French in the French American War, they fought against Britain in the War of Independence, and they destroyed the Spanish in the Spanish-American War. The French, the British and the Spanish: those are the three horns America plucked up.

“In this horn were eyes like the eyes of man”, meaning great vision. It was America that had the vision to say: we are going to create a railroad, weapons of mass destruction, means of communication like no one has ever seen before, ships that can go to the moon. It is America that created these great inventions.

“And a mouth speaking great things”: there is no God, and if there is a God, surely he looks like the white man. We are going to the moon, because we are God. Man came from monkeys. We are going to fly above the heights of the clouds: 1903, the Wright brothers; 1969, we are going to the moon. Jesus is white. These are the great things the mouth would speak.

This is the reward Ezra wanted to know about. “Until the Ancient of days came”: the Ancient of days is the Most High. All that America has done is until the Ancient of days came. “And judgment was given to the saints of the most High”: that judgment is the reward we are going to get, the reward of power, of salvation. Judgment means reward; power is going to be given to the saints of the Most High, and the saints are the 12 tribes of Israel.

“And the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.” That is our reward, brothers: the time is going to come when we possess this kingdom on earth.

“The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth”. Brothers, sisters, we are living in the fourth kingdom; we are living under the fourth beast. It is “diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth”. It goes from Rome to the United States of America. It “shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.”

“The ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise”: the EU, NATO. “And another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.” That is the United States of America, the little horn that plucked up three of the first horns.

“He shall speak great words against the most High”: we already read and explained the mouth speaking great things. “And shall wear out the saints of the most High”: he wore us out in slavery. They not only enslaved us, they colonized us, they forced us to have a loss of identity, and they oppressed us.

“And think to change times and laws”: they changed God’s times and God’s laws. They said: let’s change the new moon; no longer will it be the full moon, make it the dark moon. We know God says the Sabbath is the seventh day of the week, which we call Saturday; let’s make it Sunday. The Lord said observe Passover; they said celebrate Easter. The evening and the morning were the first day; they said the day starts with sunrise, no longer at the evening. The law says man shall not lie with mankind as he does with a woman; they made laws that say it is okay in Jesus’ name for the same sex to get together. Another law: feminism. Women don’t got to be submissive unto the man, the woman is over the man. That is white man doctrine, just like the serpent in the garden: you don’t have to listen to him.

This goes back to what the Archangel Uriel was telling Ezra about: the great seed of evil, of wickedness.

“And they shall be given into his hand”. The they is the Israelites, given into the hand of the fourth kingdom, the fourth beast. Ezra called it the eagle, and this is that eagle: the eagle of the United States of America, with the flag behind it. The fourth beast is Rome and America.

“Until a time and times and the dividing of time”: that is three and a half, which equals 350 years.

“But the judgment shall sit”: God’s judgment shall still stand. “And they shall take away his dominion”: the Israelites shall take away the fourth beast’s dominion.

“To consume and to destroy it unto the end.” To consume is you men teaching the word of God, and you sisters teaching your children: we consume him with the word of God. To destroy is Christ, coming to destroy him.

“And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven”: that means the whole planet earth. It “shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High”, to the Twelve Tribes of Israel. “Whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom”: our kingdom shall be an everlasting kingdom.

All the nations on the planet earth “shall serve and obey him.” The him is Christ. We are going to force everybody to bow the knee.
“Hitherto is the end of the matter.” Brothers, sisters, that is what the whole Bible is about. Never give up.

precepts.why:
The three ribs in the bear’s mouth are named here. “Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt”: one of the ribs was Egypt. “And merchandise of Ethiopia”: the second rib was Ethiopia. “And of the Sabeans”: the third rib was the Sabeans, that is Somalia. “Men of stature”: tall men.

They “shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine”, “they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee”, saying “there is none else, there is no God.” They came under Persia because God gave Cyrus authority.

Read verse 1 so you know who verse 14 is talking about: “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus”. Cyrus was the king of Persia. So the nations of verse 14, Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans, are the three ribs between the teeth of the bear, the Medes and the Persians.

The Bible tells you what the fourth beast is, not Godzilla. “This is the interpretation of the vision: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel.” The eagle is Daniel’s fourth beast. “But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.” Daniel was not given the meaning; Ezra was.

This is the eagle Ezra saw: “there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads.” The eagle is the Roman Empire. “And three heads”: three major empires, Rome, America and Britain. Those are the three major heads.

Judgment is given to the saints of the Most High, and this tells you who the saints are: “He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel”. The children of Israel are the only saints in the Holy Bible.

There is no Baptist saints, no Catholic saints, no Muslim saints, no Chinese saints, no white folk saints, no Japanese, no Arab saints. Only the 12 tribes of Israel.

To consume and to destroy: Paul shows the same thing. “And then shall that Wicked be revealed”. Who is that? The fourth beast, the fourth kingdom. In Thessalonians he is also called the son of perdition: another metaphor for the same country, the same people.

“Whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth”. That is where you brothers come in. We are consuming him with the spirit of God’s mouth, and the spirit of God’s mouth is the Holy Bible. The Bible is going to speak for itself; you men must go on, preach and teach the words of the Most High.

“And shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”. After we consume this man with the words of God’s mouth, Christ is going to come and destroy him with the brightness of his coming. That is Daniel 7:26: to consume, and to destroy it unto the end.

sense.text:
Christians love this verse: “That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow”. We know that won’t be his name in the kingdom, because he has a new name. At the name of Jesus means at the word of God. “Of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth”.

This is the all dominions serving and obeying him of Daniel 7:27. But we read in Revelation that the nations are not going to repent. So how are these nations going to bow the knee? It ain’t gonna bow willingly. We are going to force them, with the power we shall be given, to bow the knee. They have two options: nations, bow the knee or die.

precepts.why:
“And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God”. This is the white man and all the nations. They “repented not to give him glory.” You think the nations are going to repent and give the Lord glory? They are not. It says they repented not.

“And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast”: America. “And his kingdom was full of darkness”: this is the kingdom full of darkness. They “blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.” They are not repenting of their deeds.

“And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.” There is going to be war, and more wars, amongst all nations.

“And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon”: that is the politicals; people fight for political reasons. “And out of the mouth of the beast”: they fight for economic reasons. “And out of the mouth of the false prophet”: they fight for religious reasons, Christianity. “For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.”

Nobody is going to repent. So the knees of Philippians 2:10 will not bow on their own.

How will the nations bow the knee if they won’t repent? “Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie”: a bunch of liars. “Behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.” Christ is going to make them bow and worship. That is what every knee shall bow means.

Every knee shall bow. “And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers”: the kings of the other nations and the queens of the other nations. “They shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth”: that is every knee shall bow. “And lick up the dust of thy feet”: they are going to lick the dust of our feet.

“And thou shalt know that I am the Lord: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.” We got to wait on the Lord, brothers, to do this thing.

“The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee”. That is the white man, that is the Arabs, that is the Chinese, that is all nations on the earth. That is every knee shall bow.

They that despised thee “shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.” We shall be called the city of the Lord, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
Two options: bow the knee or die. “For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish”.

Some of you like to join with other nations, and this is what the Bible says about you too. “But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them”: they will not repent, they refuse to bow the knee. “Bring hither, and slay them before me.” That’s Jesus. That’s the loving Jesus. Your church ain’t never said nothing like this to you.
